notes: Amaze is a membership for everyday care, not insurance. It does not pay hospital, ER, surgery or specialist bills — that is what the Cigna plan is for.
The price is $99.99 a month from the October training. Kyle quotes $99, and Amaze's own site prints no price. Click the price on the row to change it if the client's figure differs.

Do not sell it as a copay saver: $99.99 a month is $1,199.88 a year, and five primary-care visits on Cigna 7350 cost $250 in copays. It buys any-time access and breadth. On the HSA plans, where every visit is deductible + 20%, it does replace real money.
No prescription list is on file for Amaze or Rx Valet. Check a drug's price in the Rx Valet app; do not quote a savings percentage or a pharmacy count.
Second opinions are not a stated feature anywhere in Amaze's material — do not promise one.
Do not repeat Amaze's own usage or ER-reduction percentages; they are company claims.
If the membership is cancelled the free features stay (search, video library, symptom checker); the medical care is what the subscription buys.
Enrol through your own Amaze sign-up link (Setup). The link decides who is credited.
